name: Release

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    tags: ['*']
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  source:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install build tools
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y cmake build-essential

      - name: Configure
        run: cmake -S . -B build

      - name: Build
        run: cmake --build build

      - name: Package source tarball
        run: cpack -G TBZ2 -C Release -B build

      - name: Package source zip
        run: cpack -G ZIP -C Release -B build

      - name: Upload source artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: source
          path: |
            build/Gammu-*.tar.bz2
            build/Gammu-*.zip

  windows-installer:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Build Windows installer
        uses: ./.github/actions/windows-installer
        with:
          build_type: Release
          run_tests: false

      - name: Upload installer artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: windows-installer
          path: |
            build/*.exe

  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [source, windows-installer]
    if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/')
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Download source artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: source

      - name: Download installer artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: windows-installer

      - name: Find source tarball
        id: tarball
        run: echo "path=$(find . -name '*.tar.bz2' | head -n 1)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Find source zip
        id: zip
        run: echo "path=$(find . -name '*.zip' | head -n 1)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Find installer exe
        id: installer
        run: echo "path=$(find . -name '*.exe' | head -n 1)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Create release
        id: create_release
        uses: actions/create-release@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          release_name: Release ${{ github.ref_name }}
          draft: false
          prerelease: false

      - name: Upload source tarball
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.upload_url }}
          asset_path: ${{ steps.tarball.outputs.path }}
          asset_name: Gammu-${{ github.ref_name }}.tar.bz2
          asset_content_type: application/x-bzip2

      - name: Upload source zip
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.upload_url }}
          asset_path: ${{ steps.zip.outputs.path }}
          asset_name: Gammu-${{ github.ref_name }}.zip
          asset_content_type: application/zip

      - name: Upload Windows installer
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.upload_url }}
          asset_path: ${{ steps.installer.outputs.path }}
          asset_name: Gammu-${{ github.ref_name }}-installer.exe
          asset_content_type: application/octet-stream
